_comment: Tier-2: ShallowWaterApplication is depth-averaged, hence 2D only. Pitfall (kratos.shallow_water #1, '2D only (depth-averaged)'). The catalog's Signal for this entry is the shared 'Convergence is not achieved' boilerplate, which is NOT the real behaviour: the constraint is enforced by the element registry. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 / ShallowWaterApplication 10.4.3: BoussinesqElement2D3N and 2D4N construct, while every 3D spelling (BoussinesqElement3D4N/3D8N, ShallowWaterElement3D4N) raises 'is not registered'. This fixture imports KratosMultiphysics for real; with Kratos absent the import fails, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure/skip, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS the expected registration status of all 5 entities -- it claims the opposite of what this build registers, while still really calling CreateNewElement/CreateNewCondition for each name. Every registered[...] line then disagrees with itself and registry_mismatches goes from 0 to 5. This proves the booleans come from a real registry lookup on this build and that a wrong claim is caught. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 5 registered[<name>]=<got>_expected=<must> lines, registry_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/shallowwater_is_2d_only && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
